note: service server: ./forgejo was a path relative to the compose file; it is now the managed volume server-forgejo. Write it as a bind mount to keep it a directory you can see
note: service server: container_name is ignored: the instance is named for the service, which is the name siblings use
note: service server: networks is ignored: a stack gets its own network from #177
